summary_en: Upper limit: ¥5,000M for up to 3,500,000 shares (5.73% S/O ex-treasury). Execution window: Aug 7–Dec 23, 2026. Method: open-market via ToSTNeT-3. All acquired shares to be cancelled as of Jan 29, 2027. Stated rationale: capital-efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns aligned with next-period medium-term strategy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Treasury Stock Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On Aug 6, 2026, Kurimoto Ltd.'s board of directors resolved to acquire up to 3,500,000 treasury shares (5.73% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at a maximum total outlay of ¥5,000M during the period Aug 7–Dec 23, 2026. The method is open-market purchase via ToSTNeT-3 (off-board auction). All shares acquired are to be cancelled, with the cancellation effective Jan 29, 2027. The company states this buyback is undertaken to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns by operationalizing the capital-allocation direction ahead of the next medium-term plan, while maintaining balance between growth investment, financial soundness, and shareholder returns. As of July 31, 2026, the company had 61,107,655 shares outstanding (ex-treasury) and held 2,884,795 treasury shares.
